import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { address } from "./address";
import { customer } from "./customer";
import { inventory } from "./inventory";
import { staff } from "./staff";

export const store = defineTable("store", {
    columns: {
        storeId: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        managerStaffId: col.integer().notNull().unique(),
        addressId: col.integer().notNull(),
        lastUpdate: col.timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().onCreateNow()
    },
    relations: {
        address: rel.belongsTo(() => address),
        customer: rel.hasMany(() => customer),
        inventory: rel.hasMany(() => inventory),
        staff: rel.hasMany(() => staff)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
